quiz_title: Web Design Advanced - Quiz 4: JS Operators & Control Flow

questions.q: Which operator checks if two values are equal in JavaScript?
questions.exp: The double equals (==) operator compares two values to see if they are equal!

questions.q: Which logical operator represents AND, requiring BOTH sides to be true?
questions.exp: && (AND) evaluates true ONLY if both left and right conditional criteria evaluate true!

questions.q: Which conditional block handles options if an IF statement evaluates false?
questions.exp: The 'else' block holds fallback code triggered when the parent IF condition fails.

questions.q: Which loop always executes its code block at least ONCE before validating parameters?
questions.exp: do-while loops run the block first, then check conditions at the bottom of the loop!

questions.q: How do you increment a counter variable 'i' by 1 in loop syntax?
questions.exp: The increment operator i++ adds exactly 1 to variables, commonly used in loop counters!
